description: Change the recording notice or AI notice callers hear before the greeting, or when each plays. The next call uses the new wording. Requires the business owner. Turning a notice to never can break recording or AI-disclosure law for callers in states that require one; state_gated is the safe default. Every change is logged with the previous value.

ai_disclosure_enabled.description: Legacy switch; false turns the AI notice off entirely.

ai_disclosure_message.description: What callers hear about talking to an AI. Up to 300 characters.

business_id.description: Business ID (optional only when the token has exactly one accessible business)

dry_run.description: Validate and show the proposed settings without writing.

record_calls_by_default.description: Whether calls are recorded. With recording off, no recording notice plays.

recording_disclosure_message.description: What callers hear about recording, e.g. "This call is recorded." Up to 300 characters.

name: set_call_disclosures
title: Set Call Disclosures
